scope: Local ingestion snapshot, normalized using the app source at appCommit. Rendering success is not a claim of visual equivalence, production inventory completeness or adoption.

node.methodology: One timed implementation per fresh process; four comparison pairs and two identical-source control pairs; balanced AB/BA process order; same iteration count within a pair; warmup and result validation outside timing; raw samples retained without trimming. Per-process medians are the comparison units. This limits JIT cross-contamination and order effects; it does not eliminate environmental noise.

summary.evidence: lower time in every pair, beyond control spread
